## Where I am

SAML login now works end to end on staging with Fernhill's IdP after the short RelayState fix. JIT provisioning (#415) is merged. Group-to-role mapping is in PR #421, which is still open. (source: s3-11, s3-04, s3-06, src-pr415)

- [en-cours] Group-to-role mapping (`saml_role_mapping`: Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins to admin, default viewer), waiting for review and merge of PR #421 (source: s3-06, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim to their assertion; Daniel emails them (source: s3-05, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Once the claim exists, test with one admin account besides kestrel.test1 (source: s3-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Demo with Fernhill IT, Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET (source: src-linear-kes311, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] SP-initiated login failed: Fernhill's ADFS rejects a RelayState over 80 bytes, and the return URL was 143 bytes. Fixed by sending a 16-byte opaque ID, with the URL stored in Redis for 600 s (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [question] Fernhill IT's Slack message asks for IdP-initiated login only and an analyst default role. This conflicts with the decisions below, and the analyst role does not exist yet (source: src-slack-fernhill, s3-07)
- [question] A note says SSO is enforced for all Fernhill users on Dec 1, with password login disabled. No team source confirms this (source: src-note-enforce, src-linear-kes311)
- [décision] SP-initiated login stays on (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Default role stays viewer until Maya talks to Fernhill (source: s3-07)
- [décision] JIT creates users only from verified domains (source: src-pr415)
- [décision] SAML only, no OIDC for now (source: s1-03)
